availability.note: Chery AU has no Build & Price; model page lists two grades (Urban, Ultimate) with live postcode pricing via /api/dynamic-pricing/car-variant/3409: VIC 3000 and VIC 3350 $36,478, NSW 2000 $36,247, no postcode $34,990 drive-away. CarExpert 2026 price list carries the same two FWD grades (20260701 release)

listPrice.note: CarExpert: 'prices starting at $32,990 before on-road costs' (released to market 3 July 2026). Reconciled with Chery's own Victorian drive-away (manufacturer price): Chery API $36,478 for VIC 3000; Chery footnote [T14/T15] says it includes RRP, 12 months rego, CTP, DEALER DELIVERY and stamp duty. App drive-away at 32,990 = $35,255.58, so implied delivery = (36478-35255.58)/1.042 = $1,173, identical on both grades and identical to chery-e5's implied ~$1,173 (a figure Chery did not choose per grade). Plain back-out ((36478-880)/1.042) = 34,163 round-trips to $36,477.85 but overstates the list by the delivery charge (sources.md price rule 4). National no-postcode DAP $34,990 = MSRP + $2,000, the same flat pattern found on jaecoo-j7-shs. $2,000 cashback (1 Nov-21 Dec 2026) is a campaign and ignored. Held 2026-07-28 list was $37,990

batteryKwh.note: AU MY26 spec sheet 'Battery Capacity (kWh) 18.4' LFP; gross/usable not stated (CarExpert/NRMA say 18.3 kWh); treated as usable as on jaecoo-j7-shs and chery-tiggo-8-phev

rangeKm.note: Chery UK TIGGO 7 CSH 'Electric Range (WLTP mile) 56' = 90 km, 18.4 kWh, 18in wheels as AU (AU 225/60 R18). AU spec sheet 'Electric Range (NEDC km) 93' (ADR 81/02) is higher than WLTP: rejected per direction test

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm x 100 = 18.4/90 x 100 = 20.4; AU 163 Wh/km is the NEDC ADR label, not used per field rules

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: Chery UK 'Fuel Consumption - Combined (MPG) 47.08' = 6.0 L/100km, read as charge-sustaining (a weighted WLTP figure would be ~1 L/100km; same reading as jaecoo-j7-shs on Jaecoo UK 47.1 mpg). Corroborated by CarExpert review: Chery said 6.0L/100km was realistic; NRMA saw 3.8, The Beep ~4 once depleted. Held 5.5 was a review average; changed to 6.0 for consistency with jaecoo-j7-shs and chery-tiggo-8-phev on the same powertrain

combinedRangeKm.note: 90 WLTP + 60 L tank (AU spec sheet 'Fuel Tank Capacity (L) 60') / 6.0 x 100 = 1090. Chery's 1,200 km claim is built on NEDC range

isGreenForVicDuty.note: SRO: green passenger car has combined tailpipe CO2 of 120 g/km or less; AU spec sheet 'CO2 Emissions - Combined 33 g/km'

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: CarExpert review: Chery quotes no PHEV figure; 356 L 'with the rear seats in place (to the top of the seats)' for the Tiggo 7 Pro (549 to the roof). CarExpert variant data also lists VDA 'rear seat up; to lower window 356 L' for this grade. Battery sits under the passenger compartment (AU spec sheet 'Battery Position Lower Passenger Compartment'), so the PHEV loses the underfloor bin, not cargo-cover volume

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: The Beep: 'the related petrol car offers 356 litres with the seats up and 1676 litres folded'; measurement standard not stated and almost certainly to the roof (549 L seats-up to roof); no belt-line or PHEV-specific folded figure published. Not scaled, to stay consistent with jaecoo-j7-shs which also uses a to-roof folded figure

towKg.note: AU spec sheet lists only 'Maximum Towing Mass (Non-Braked Trailer) 750'; no braked rating, so 0

warrantyYears.note: '7-year unlimited kilometre warranty'; separate 8-year unlimited km HV battery warranty; no dealer-servicing condition on the page

insuranceAnnual.note: matched to jaecoo-j7-shs-track (same Chery 18.4 kWh SHS powertrain, $37,990, 1450, which was itself anchored to this row); list price cut $5,000 but byd-sealion-5-essential ($33,990) sits at a similar level; kept at held 1450

depreciationCurve.note: Chery brand convention used by every Chery, Omoda and Jaecoo row (chery-e5, chery-tiggo-8/9-phev, jaecoo-j7-shs). Below mainstream on evidence of a $5,000 list and drive-away cut since launch ($39,990 to $34,990 national DAP on Urban) plus a further $2,000 cashback Nov-Dec 2026
